'''2021 Worlds Throwback Event''' (Prem-RefII) was the Players Committee Premiere–Reflections II constructed event at the 2021 World Championship weekend in Arlington, Virginia, 8 October 2021. [[Stephen Skilton]] finished 1st in the published field of 16.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-worlds-retro-prem-ref-ii-event/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Site:''' Arlington, Virginia (Washington, D.C.)
* '''Dates:''' 8 October 2021
* '''GEMP importable decks:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-10-worlds-throwback-prem-refii-event/ forum]
